scores.reasons: The best-run web presence in the batch, so the gap is small and the work is incremental; a three-school martial arts group with monthly tuition and birthday-party revenue should be able to pay; automation opportunities are well-defined and low-risk; evidence is strong, including an actively managed Google profile.

caveats: All ratings were read from the public Google Maps listing on 2026-11-12; Google served a 'limited view' of Maps in this environment, so review counts were only visible for businesses where an aggregator or the business's own site published them.

Mobile layout checks used Chrome device emulation at 390px width with screenshots. The two Wix-built sites (Muscle Mill, Embrace Wellness) reported a layout width of ~1020-1041px at a 390px viewport, i.e. the desktop layout is being served to phones; this is what a real phone would show, but the underlying cause (mobile version not configured in the site editor) is an inference.
Agent-readiness scores follow the 'findable / answerable / bookable' rubric: 0 = nothing, 3 = an outside AI assistant could complete the task unaided.
Empower Martial Arts is a three-location New Jersey group, not a national chain or franchise, so it was treated as a local business rather than excluded.

Embrace Wellness is listed in the batch at 23 N Main St, Milltown and does have a Google listing there, but its site also carries a 3996 County Road 516, Matawan address; the Milltown studio is the location assessed.
data_gaps: Google review counts could not be read for Diamond Nails, The Muscle Mill, Phoenix Fitness, Flow Yoga, Embrace Wellness and Empower Martial Arts because Google Maps rendered a limited view without the review total; aggregator counts are given where they existed and are labelled as such.

Zuzanna Esthetics' website returned HTTP 500 on every attempt, so its content, booking setup, page titles/descriptions and schema could not be reviewed; the cached description in search results was not treated as current.

Flow Yoga's Bookee booking widget (https://flowyoga.onbookee.com/class-schedule) never finished loading in a fresh browser, so class times, prices and whether an AI assistant could complete a booking could not be verified; the finding is recorded as unconfirmed rather than broken.

No robots.txt exists on phx.fitness (404), so crawler access was assessed from that absence rather than a policy file; Fixx Beauty Bar and Lavelle Esthetics run on platform domains (Square), where robots.txt reflects the platform, not the business.

Super Nails' public reviews were only partially readable (one complaint quoted in summary form from Birdeye); a full review read would need the Google reviews panel, which the limited Maps view did not expose.
